page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The server features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Additionally, the instance includes 1229 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU testing placing in the top 25% at 2702.58. Memory performance is also a highlight, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top 25%. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top-tier performance in text generation for small language models at 334.98 tokens per second. However, multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations generally fall within the average range. A notable performance tradeoff is observed in large-scale language model processing, where prompt processing for a 70B model is weak, landing in the bottom 25%.

Given its high memory density and bundled local SSD storage, the E32ads_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require dedicated GPU acceleration. The combination of 256 GB of RAM and fast local SSD storage makes this instance highly suitable for relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications. It is also well-suited for software compilation and image processing tasks, though it is less optimal for large-scale LLM inference.
